name: COMP_062
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (90%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set and reliable input, but the second model (MUSK) disagrees and InSitu holds 10%. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 90%, InSitu 10% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top classes differ |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 Benign | Moderate support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Intraductal atypia** (regions 3, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; concept model reads as non-invasive [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below typical; little infiltrative pattern [F3] · Validated
- **Benign stroma or fat** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Scarcer than typical; modest push toward invasive [F4] · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Below typical; small push toward invasive · Unreliable
- **Nuclear pleomorphism** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below typical; small push away from invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules Unreliable (0/20); intraductal atypia Weak.

## Could be wrong if
- The second model (MUSK) picks a different top class; its choice is not shown.
- Intraductal atypia, a Weak concept, reflects in-situ disease; 2 of 5 similar cases are InSitu.

## Check on the slide
1. **3, 5, 6** — Assess intraductal atypia: benign proliferation versus in situ carcinoma.
2. **0** — Confirm stroma is benign with no infiltrating tumor.
3. **10** — Check nuclear pleomorphism and gland formation.
